an5.226:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā kulūpagassa bhikkhuno ativelaṃ kulesu saṃsaṭṭhassa viharato.
an5.226:1.7: otiṇṇacittassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: anabhirato vā brahmacariyaṃ carissati, aññataraṃ vā saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjissati, sikkhaṃ vā paccakkhāya hīnayāvattissati.
an5.226:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā kulūpagassa bhikkhuno ativelaṃ kulesu saṃsaṭṭhassa viharatoti.
